title: Detailed and Eddy Current Inspection of the Rear Pressure Bulkhead Outer Radial Segments
abstract: Inspection of the six outer radial segments of the rear pressure bulkhead web and of the circumferential joint, combining a detailed visual check with an eddy current scan of the outermost fastener row.

sections.purpose: This task finds cracking in the outer radial segments of the rear pressure bulkhead web and at the circumferential joint where the segments meet the fuselage frame. It is the scheduled structural inspection for the area on ZEPHYR-24 aircraft.
sections.job_setup_note: The rear galley, the aft lavatories and the aft cargo compartment lining have to be removed for access, so plan at least one shift for access and one for restoration. The bulkhead face is a confined space with poor natural light; a second person must remain outside the access opening at all times. The cabin must be depressurised and the outflow valve locked open.
sections.procedure: 1. Remove the rear galley monuments and the aft cabin lining to expose the forward face of the bulkhead. 2. Get access to the aft cargo compartment through zones 143 and 146 and remove the ceiling lining. WARNING: THE AREA BEHIND THE BULKHEAD IS A CONFINED SPACE. A SECOND PERSON MUST REMAIN AT THE ACCESS OPENING AT ALL TIMES. 3. Clean the web and the circumferential joint and remove any loose sealant. 4. Do a detailed visual inspection of each of the six outer radial segments under a light level of at least 1000 lux. 5. Look particularly at the outermost fastener row where the segment meets the joint, and at the shear tie D5331135070611 at each segment root. 6. Calibrate the eddy current equipment on the reference block and record the trace. 7. Scan the outermost fastener row of each segment. CAUTION: THE WEB IS CHEM-MILLED AND ITS THICKNESS CHANGES ACROSS THE SCAN. RE-BALANCE THE PROBE AT EACH THICKNESS STEP. 8. Mark and record every indication with its segment number and its distance from the joint. 9. Inspect the outboard bracket D5331131182950 and the clevis pins AGS566056-63 for wear and correct locking. 10. Any indication makes the bulkhead unserviceable and must be reported before further flight. 11. Apply corrosion inhibiting compound to the joint after a clear inspection.
sections.close_out: Install the ceiling lining in the aft cargo compartment and the cabin lining and monuments in the rear cabin. Unlock the outflow valve. Do a cabin pressurisation leak check at the repositioned monuments. Record the inspection and the segment-by-segment result against the aircraft.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the cabin is depressurised and the outflow valve is locked open.
A second person must remain at the confined space access opening.
Use only approved low voltage lighting inside the tail cone.
Support the removed galley monuments on a padded stand.

tooling.description: Eddy current equipment with chem-mill compensation

abstract: Inspection of the six outer radial segments of the rear pressure bulkhead web and of the circumferential joint, written so that it can be absorbed into the aft fuselage retrofit package rather than run as a separate event.

Run separately the two compete for the same shop slot and the same inspector, and the aircraft pays for the access twice.
